name: Qwen3.5-9B q4f16_1, OpenAI-compatible chat
summary: Qwen3.5-9B (GatedDeltaNet hybrid: 75% recurrent linear-attention layers, 25% GQA) quantized to q4f16_1 for WebLLM/WebGPU. Entries preserve the OpenAI-compatible chat contract while tuning runtime and model-library artifacts for a specific browser/GPU configuration.

source.precision: q4f16_1 weights, float16 activations and KV cache

request.tools: Optional OpenAI-compatible tool declarations; they disable the catalog's exact-greedy fast path when they install a grammar or logit processor.
request.stream: Boolean. Streaming chunks follow WebLLM's OpenAI-compatible delta shape.

response.text: choices[0].message.content for non-streaming, or concatenated choices[0].delta.content for streaming.
response.usage: OpenAI-compatible prompt/completion token counts plus WebLLM latency fields when enabled.

generation.fastPath: Exact greedy GPU-resident decode (burst size per entry) only when temperature is zero and no logprobs, penalties, grammar, logit bias, structured output, or custom logit processor is active.
generation.fallback: All other requests use the normal WebLLM one-token sampler and keep the same API contract.

verification.case: Six rotating fresh LaTeX prompts plus four math/prose/code/low-margin quality prompts.
verification.bar: Eight of eight fresh-prompt pairs are byte-identical to the published subgroup-32 path, with matching completion-token counts. Four of four quality prompts are byte-identical to local K=1 full-vocabulary argmax. The published temperature-zero sampler is not deterministic on the prose quality item, so that item is not a published-path exactness claim.

notes: Weights and tokenizer remain in the immutable upstream MLC repository. The catalog entry carries metadata plus verified runtime JS and model-library WASM references. This model is a GatedDeltaNet hybrid (recurrent RNNState on 75% of layers, paged GQA KV cache on 25%); the published max_history_size:1 cannot survive a burst rollback, so the loader must raise ChatOptions.max_history_size to at least burst+1 for this family (see the entry's provenance ledger). TVM_WEBGPU_GEMV_TR is a verified no-op for this model's compiled kernels.
